solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Winner given embrace by old writer

parts.note: a winner is a victor
an embrace is a hug

explanation.surface: A champion is warmly hugged by a veteran author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given' and 'by' just join the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor Hugo was the French novelist behind Les Misérables, so he is a writer.

clue.text: Reserve following very bad habit

indicators.note: following says the reserve piece comes after the very piece

parts.note: reserve as cool aloofness is ice in one's manner

explanation.surface: Holding back after being very keen proves a bad habit.
explanation.definitionFit: A vice is a moral failing or wicked habit, a synonym for a bad habit.

clue.text: Weigh up ordinary member in custody

indicators.note: in places the ordinary and member pieces inside the custody piece

parts.note: children in custody are in care
MP, member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Assess a rank-and-file politician who is being held in custody.
explanation.definitionFit: To compare things is to weigh them up against one another, a synonym.

clue.text: Very angry, orphan that we upset

indicators.note: upset means knocked over and disturbed, so the three words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone furious about an orphan whom we have distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like part of the emotional picture but rearranges ORPHAN THAT WE.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on the warpath is an idiom for being angry and ready for a fight.

clue.text: Figure pathogen's spread

indicators.note: spread means scattered about, so the letters of the germ word are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Statistics show how a germ has spread through the population.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure' looks like a number about the disease, but it is the shape being defined.
explanation.definitionFit: A heptagon is a seven-sided plane shape, an example of a geometric figure.

clue.text: Talkative type making joke about small airline

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the joke piece goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a gag is a joke
BA is British Airways, the UK flag-carrier airline

explanation.surface: A chatterbox cracking a joke about a minor airline.
explanation.definitionFit: A gasbag is an informal term for someone who talks too much, a chatterbox.

clue.text: Cunning tramp miles away

indicators.note: miles away means the letter for miles is removed from the tramp word

parts.note: to tramp is to march

explanation.surface: A wily vagrant has wandered miles off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tramp' looks like a vagrant noun but is the verb, to march.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch means knowing or mischievously cunning, as in an arch look.

clue.text: Raging bull with ear infection

indicators.note: raging means wild and out of control, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A furious bull is suffering from an ear infection.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubella, German measles, is a viral illness, an example of an infection.

clue.text: Axe project in severe reduction

parts.note: a hatchet is a small axe
a job is a task or project

explanation.surface: A scheme to make cuts that is part of a drastic cutback.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatchet job is an idiom for a savage cut or a harsh critical demolition.

clue.text: Happen to reach route through mountains

parts.note: to reach a total or a place is to come to it
a pass is a way through a mountain range

explanation.surface: An explorer wonders whether they will reach the mountain pass.
explanation.definitionFit: To come to pass is an old idiom meaning to happen or occur.

clue.text: Touch a bottom? Almost

indicators.note: almost means not quite complete, so the final letter of the bottom word is dropped

parts.note: a butt is slang for a bottom

explanation.surface: Is a quick feel of someone's backside nearly a touch?
explanation.definitionFit: Things that abut touch along a shared edge, a synonym for touch.

clue.text: Travel times? Directors get lost

parts.note: to travel is to go
by is the multiplication sign, as in two by three
the directors of a company form the board

explanation.surface: Board members consult timetables for their journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'times' looks like timetable times; it is the multiplication 'by'.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that go by the board are lost or abandoned, as if thrown overboard.

clue.text: Free bar

definitions.meaning: bar as a preposition means except

explanation.definitionFit: Save means rescue, a synonym of free, and save means except, a synonym of bar.

clue.text: Governess bringing in a ring for religious leader

indicators.note: bringing in means taking inside, so the governess word holds the other pieces

parts.note: an ayah is a nanny or governess in India
to ring a bell is to toll it

explanation.surface: A nanny summons a holy man by ringing a bell.
explanation.definitionFit: An ayatollah is a senior Shia Muslim cleric, a religious leader.

clue.text: Losing ground, ground in part of New York

indicators.note: ground as the past of grind means crushed, so the letters of the first word are rearranged

parts.note: ground is land

explanation.surface: A team is losing ground in a district of New York.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'ground' does two different jobs: crushed and earth.
explanation.definitionFit: Long Island is the large island east of Manhattan, part of New York State.

clue.text: Machinist's function

definitions.meaning: a machinist is someone who runs a machine
in mathematics a function or mapping such as differentiation is a named symbol of this kind

explanation.surface: A factory worker's role on the shop floor.
explanation.definitionFit: One who works a machine is a machine operator, and in mathematics an operator is a function acting on others.

clue.text: Hold forth against extremely touchy taskmaster

indicators.note: extremely means at the extremes, so the outer letters of touchy are taken

parts.note: to hold forth is to rant

explanation.surface: Ranting at an oversensitive slave-driver.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant is an oppressive, demanding ruler, much like a harsh taskmaster.

clue.text: Where Richmond is unspoilt, I assume initially

parts.note: virgin means untouched and unspoilt

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the first letter of assume is taken

explanation.surface: A visitor supposes Richmond is unspoilt.
explanation.walkthrough: Richmond is the capital of the US state Virginia, not the London suburb.
explanation.definitionFit: Richmond is the state capital of Virginia, so the state is where it is.

clue.text: Complain about onset of pig flu

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the complain word goes round the letter

parts.note: to gripe is to complain

indicators.note: onset means start, so the first letter of pig is taken

explanation.surface: Moaning about the arrival of swine flu.
explanation.definitionFit: Grippe is an old-fashioned word, from French, for influenza.

clue.text: One with Ms West drinking gin in picture

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: drinking means taking in, so the West piece holds the gin

parts.note: Mae West was the American film star

explanation.surface: Someone joins the actress Mae West as she sips gin in a film.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine is to picture something in the mind, a synonym.

clue.text: Until now other resort's linked to strike

indicators.note: linked to says the rearranged letters are attached to the strike piece

parts.note: to strike is to hit

indicators.note: resort means sort again, so the letters of other are rearranged

explanation.surface: Until now the other holiday town had a rail link to the coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday town but means re-sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitherto is a formal adverb meaning up to this time, until now.

clue.text: End of December hold-up involved a seasonal visitor

indicators.note: end means the final letter, so the last letter of December is taken
involved means tangled, so the letters of hold-up are rearranged

explanation.surface: A delay at the end of December affected a Christmas guest.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer pulls Santa's sleigh each Christmas, a festive visitor.

clue.text: Bespoke tailor in district of Venice

indicators.note: bespoke means made to order, so the letters of tailor are made into something new

explanation.surface: A made-to-measure tailor works in a part of Venice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bespoke' belongs with tailor in the surface but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rialto is the famous bridge and market area of Venice, a district of the city.

clue.text: Extraordinary beginning involving league's leader

indicators.note: involving means taking in, so the beginning word holds the letter

parts.note: beginning is starting

indicators.note: leader means first, so the first letter of league is taken

explanation.surface: An unusual start to the season involves the league leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Startling means surprising or astonishing, close to extraordinary.

clue.text: Lad holding key for the trunk

indicators.note: holding means containing, so the lad word goes round the key

parts.note: a lad is a boy
D is a musical key

explanation.surface: A boy holds the key for a luggage trunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' looks like luggage but means the torso.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk of a person is the torso, the main part of the body.

clue.text: Song suggested by that man on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio means broadcast so it is heard, signalling a sound-alike

parts.note: that man is him

explanation.surface: A tune that a broadcaster has suggested.
explanation.definitionFit: A hymn is a religious song of praise.

clue.text: A monarch not quite sharing common origin

indicators.note: not quite means falling short, so the last letter of the monarch word is dropped

parts.note: a monarch is a king

explanation.surface: A king who is almost a relative of royalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Akin means related by blood or of the same family, sharing a common origin.

clue.text: Unable to see colleague crossing far side of wide cul-de-sac

parts.note: blind means unable to see

indicators.note: crossing means lying across, so the colleague word straddles the letter

parts.note: an ally is a colleague or partner

indicators.note: far side means the end, so the last letter of wide is taken

explanation.surface: A sightless colleague crosses a broad dead-end street.
explanation.definitionFit: A blind alley is a lane closed at one end, a dead end or cul-de-sac.

clue.text: Fight anticipated by Left

parts.note: something anticipated is due, expected

explanation.surface: A clash was expected from the political left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A duel is a formal combat between two people, a fight.

clue.text: Occasionally won hand with ten high

indicators.note: high means intoxicated and unsteady, so the letters of the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A card player sometimes wins a hand with ten high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high' sounds like a card term but rearranges WON HAND TEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Now and then is an idiom meaning from time to time, occasionally.
